title: Flipping the Script on Criminal Justice Risk Assessment: An actuarial model for assessing the risk the federal sentencing system poses to defendants
reasoning: The paper features a dedicated section (Section 7, 'Embedded Values Choices') that critically evaluates the normative and ethical choices inherent in model design, variable selection, and risk assessment formulation. It explicitly discusses how moral and ethical considerations should guide the development of actuarial tools in the legal system.
